title: CLOISTERFALL joins the Games Library: 47 paid games, still $14.99
body:
CLOISTERFALL is in the CSAF Games Library from today. That makes 47 paid games on this page, still $14.99.

CLOISTERFALL is a gothic action platformer for Windows: 20 rooms of one fallen abbey, from the Cloister down through the Ossuary to the Undercroft, with three bosses and three relics. A hunter with a hand axe and a quick dash fights down through it, and nothing hits him without a warning first: a red diamond and a floor mark, a tightening ring, a drawn sight line, a red strip or ring where a boss's blow will land. Knockback never throws you off a ledge or into spikes, and a hit gives you a moment to get clear. The map pins every door you have seen with the relic it needs.

It has no page of its own yet, so for now this Library is the only place to get it. A page of its own, with a free browser demo of the Cloister and its boss, is planned. CLOISTERFALL's own LICENSE.txt already mentions that demo, which is not published yet.

If you own the Library: open its download page and CLOISTERFALL is there as its own file, about 149 MB. No game in the other downloads changed; only their small Readme, catalogue and licence text files did (they now list 47 games), so there is nothing else you need to download again.

Also new on the page: the cover and plates show the new count, and CLOISTERFALL has a line and its own GIF under Latest additions. LAMPBLACK's GIF stays in the gallery until it has a page of its own.

If the Library gives you a good evening, a quick rating helps more than anything.
